programme.desc: WWII drama with Humphrey Bogart. A group of American soldiers race against time to reach a source of water in an abandoned fortress - but discover the Nazis are headed to the same place. (1943)

programme.title: Donovan's Reef
programme.desc: Adventure comedy with John Wayne. An American soldier settles on a South Sea island after WWII, but the arrival of his friend's daughter throws his easy-going life into turmoil. (1963)

programme.title: Star Trek - The Original Series
programme.desc: Security is stepped up on board the Enterprise in anticipation of a visit from a Medusan ambassador whose appearance can blind any onlookers. S3, Ep5/24

programme.title: The Six Million Dollar Man
programme.desc: A veteran cop is suspected of stealing atomic components. S4, Ep20

programme.title: Babylon 5
programme.desc: Ivanova's friend arrives with a legacy from her late father, and a disgraced boxer tries to prove his worth by being the first human to compete in a violent alien sporting event. S1, Ep14

programme.title: Walker, Texas Ranger
programme.desc: Chuck Norris fights crime and helps the community as the eponymous Walker. The Japanese Yakuza come to America after the death of one of their own... S1, Ep4/28

programme.title: The Shanghai Job
programme.desc: Action thriller with Orlando Bloom. A washed-up private security agent is hired to escort a valuable antique out of Shanghai, but is ambushed during the journey. (2017)

programme.title: Rise of the Footsoldier Part II
programme.desc: Crime thriller sequel with Ricci Harnett. Haunted by the loss of his best friends in the Essex Range Rover murders, gangster Carlton Leach considers leaving his violent lifestyle behind him. (2015)
